title: Household Energy ABM (SPDT): hour-by-hour residential energy demand for GeoJSON neighbourhoods
description: An agent-based model that simulates hour-by-hour residential electricity and gas demand for every dwelling in a GeoJSON neighbourhood, SERL-calibrated and validated against DESNZ subnational consumption (2020-2023), with policy levers for heat-pumps, retrofits, and socio-demographic targeting.
